question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Queer
solution:
The correct answer is "**Strange**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Queer" means strange or unusual.**(विचित्र)

 
 
• It can also mean homosexual or odd in behavior.
 
 
 
• Synonyms of queer include peculiar, eccentric, and bizarre.
 
• Example: The old house had a queer smell that made me feel uneasy.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "strange" is the synonym of the word "queer."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Expedite means to make something happen faster.(शीघ्र)
 
• Ordinary means normal or average.(साधारण)
 
• Valid means legally or logically acceptable.(वैध)
